title: Codka Joogtada ah
intro: Qofkan waxaa lagu xasuustaa xigmad iyo hagitaan qoto dheer, isagoo bixinaya talo dhaafsiisan jiilalka. Hadalladoodu waxay markhaati u yihiin cibaadada iyo muhiimadda ay leedahay in la aqoonsado nimcooyinka iyo tijaabooyinka ka imanaya Ilaah. Soo bandhig aqoonsiga naftan la ixtiraamo.
clues: Ma aanan ahayn nebi, laakiin xigmaddaydu waxay ku jirtaa Qorniinka Rabbaaniga ah.
Talada aan u jeediyay ilmahayga waxay xoogga saartay mahadnaqa Alle iyo ka fogaanshaha shirkiga.
Waxaan baray muhiimadda salaadda, faraynta wanaagga, iyo ka reebidda xumaanta.
Waxaan ka digay kibir iyo ku socoshada caro dhulka.
Magacayga waxaa la siiyay cutub dhan oo Qur'aanka ah, kaas oo iftiiminaya waxbaristayda.
Taladaydii waxaa ka mid ahayd dulqaadka dhibaatooyinka, waayo, taasi waa mid ka mid ah arrimaha ugu go'an.

location.answer: Talo xigmad leh oo ku socota farcanka

outcome.answer: Xigmaddiisa waxaa lagu diiwaan geliyay Qur'aanka Kariimka ah

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
